sheet.shortcut.moveEdgeUp: Move to the top edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.moveEdgeDown: Move to the bottom edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.moveEdgeLeft: Move to the left edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.moveEdgeRight: Move to the right edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.extendEdgeUp: Extend selection to the top edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.extendEdgeDown: Extend selection to the bottom edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.extendEdgeLeft: Extend selection to the left edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.extendEdgeRight: Extend selection to the right edge of the data
sheet.shortcut.extendSheetStart: Extend selection to beginning of sheet
sheet.shortcut.extendSheetEnd: Extend selection to end of sheet
sheet.shortcut.enter: Start editing / confirm and move down
sheet.shortcut.newlineInCell: Insert a line break in the cell
sheet.shortcut.insertRowsCols: Insert rows above (with rows selected) or columns to the left (with columns selected)
sheet.shortcut.deleteRowsCols: Delete rows (with rows selected) or columns (with columns selected)
